hypothesis.causal_question: How sensitive is complete B at primary top_k=25 to increasing Entity-score weight from 0.30 to 0.50 while preserving the same graph, gate, sequence expansion, Reader, and evaluator?
hypothesis.control: Validated complete B@25 at Entity/semantic weights 0.30/0.70.
hypothesis.treatment: Change only Entity/semantic fusion weights to 0.50/0.50.
hypothesis.family: Fusion grid is fixed before new results: existing 0.0/1.0 and 1.0/0.0 endpoints, primary 0.3/0.7, and new 0.1/0.9 plus 0.5/0.5 points. New contrasts 0.1 versus 0.3 and 0.5 versus 0.3 receive Holm correction within metric and estimator.
hypothesis.expected_direction: Higher Entity weight may strengthen graph-specific recall or reduce semantic precision; preserve favorable, null, or unfavorable results.
